question: Regarding osteoporosis it is true that:

options.opa: According to the data obtained in bone densitometry, osteoporosis is defined when T score (comparison with healthy young population of the same race and sex) is> 3.5.
options.opb: The measurement of T score is useful for the diagnosis of osteoporosis in young women. In postmenopausal women the Z score is used.
options.opc: It is indicated to administer specific drugs for the treatment of osteoporosis in menopausal women with a diagnosis of osteopenia (densitometry) and vertebral crushing, whether or not it is symptomatic.
options.opd: The action of bisphosphonates used in the treatment of osteoporosis is to activate the action of osteoblasts for the formation of bone.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: T score > 3.5 in bone densitometry -> indicative of osteoporosis -> 95% CHAIN: T score used for osteoporosis diagnosis in young women; Z score in postmenopausal women -> 90% CHAIN: Specific drugs indicated for osteoporosis treatment in menopausal women with osteopenia and vertebral crushing -> 85% CHAIN: Bisphosphonates activate osteoblasts for bone formation in osteoporosis treatment -> 95%
enhanced_information: The T score > 3.5 in bone densitometry is not indicative of osteoporosis; the correct threshold is -2.5. T score is used for osteoporosis diagnosis in both young and postmenopausal women. Specific drugs are indicated for osteoporosis treatment in menopausal women with osteopenia and vertebral crushing, whether symptomatic or not. Bisphosphonates inhibit osteoclast activity to reduce bone resorption in osteoporosis.
analysis: The core medical principle is that osteoporosis is diagnosed based on a T score threshold of -2.5 in bone densitometry. T score is used for both young and postmenopausal women. Specific drugs are indicated for osteoporosis treatment in menopausal women with osteopenia and vertebral crushing. Bisphosphonates inhibit osteoclast activity to reduce bone resorption in osteoporosis.
